text: Best purchase I've made in a long time. Ice maker in my fridge stopped making ice. This little guy takes up very little space and has been a workhorse so far!
Use this in our Travel Coach on our trips and it started making ice in about 6 minutes produces ice pretty fast. Would recommend to others to buy.

Works great. I recommend that when you turn it on and make your first batch, use cold water or just dump the first two batches back into the water bin to get the water cold so it will make larger ice cubes.
Fast and very useful in the rv. Takes up very little space while supplying gratuitous ice.
I simply love my Dellla......  I have had to reset the machine once but other than that, no problems....  This is a great buy especially since I live in an RV, with limited space....

This has to be one of the finest small kitchen appliances I've purchased here on Amazon or anywhere else for that matter!
One that will remain year-round on my limited-space kitchen counter as opposed to other contraptions that are used a few times
but eventually wind up in a basement closet to be forgotten about.
I read many reviews of countertop ice makers before deciding on this Della model. It is true that the cubes (well, they're technically not cube-shaped but rather come out of the machine like cute little hollow igloos;) do melt pretty quickly if you don't transfer them to a freezer as soon as the inside ice basket is full.
Moreover, I find that they will clump together once they freeze up a bit more (as some reviewers stated) but a couple of whacks of the bag they're in breaks them up easily. So that's no big deal for me personally.
One thing I have noted is that when the ice maker has run though all its cycles (about 4-6 if I fill it to maximum level using four 16.9 fl. oz. of bottled water), there's still quite a lot of water left in the reservoir in spite of the ADD WATER indicator turning on.
It seems a waste of water but I suppose the remainder can be recycled back into original plastic bottle & used again.
Again, not a big problem in the long run.
All this to say, the hot & humid summer weather we've been experiencing in the Northeast has been much more bearable because of this efficient & easy-to-operate ice-maker!
It drops about every 15-20 min. Works really good.

I LOVE MY DELLA ICE MACHINE. I did what some suggested about letting it set after taking it out of the box for the refrigerant fluid to resettle properly. I have made sure there's plenty of air space around it. And everyday I get two - two gallon bags of ice. I'd probably get more but I use ice all day long. If I had a complaint it would be the basket being small. But I really can't say that I get a 32 Oz container of ice per basket full. I recommend this machine.
Great little ice maker!
Works great!

Ordered this Ice Maker to replace a larger, older model.  After one week, it is working well and, because of its compact size, it fits much better on the kitchen counter top than the one we previously owned.  Impressed with the packaging from dealer.  The Ice Maker was double boxed and the outer box was very sturdy to protect it during shipping.
Love it! Makes ice in 6 mins and keeps pumping out more! Best summer purchase ever, the kids just keep scooping it out and keeping cool.
Works grate

tom in west milwaukee
I have only had mine for two months and so far I love it. But one thing I did notice is that even the large size cubes seem to melt very fast
Works well in our RV - not noisy!  Heavy enough to be stable.

I BOUGHT THIS PRODUCT DELLA ELECTRIC ICE MAKER MACHINE,IT DID WHAT OTHER PEOPLE REVIEWED,NICE SIZE ICE,DOESN'T STICK TO ANYTHING. RELIABLE MACHINE. I USE IT EVERY TWO WEEKS WHEN I NEED IT. GREAT MACHINE,COMES IN A SECURE PACKAGE AND DELIVERED ON TIME. GREAT BUY.
Great purchase
I had my doubts on Igloo brand, but so far, so good with this.
I bought this one to replace one that quit working.  It produces ice quickly and works well.  I gave it 4 starts as it is smaller than our previous one.  Great working product.
Love it. It works very well
Makes ice quick and easy.
Fast delivery, just as describe, instructions are easy to follow and works great!

I was surprised how quickly the ice makes, and easy it was to operate. The only bad side of this machine, it's a little noisey... but for the time I use it I can deal with it... I love the convenience of it,  and would purchase it again. Easy to clean.
Bought this ice maker less than five (5) months ago; it died!!! Company refused to replace. Caution!!!!

So glad I ordered this model! Works like a charm and within a few minutes you have ice ice ice ;)

***UpDate*** So I ordered this awesome ice maker 1year and 8 months ago! This bad boy is still going strong and still makes ice super fast. I tend to be a clean freak so I deep clean it once a month. Again its a must have.
Much smaller then we thought. It doesn't hold much ice. But it makes very quickly and we dump and store in a bin in our freezer.  It does a good job.
Works great. Makes ice quickly
I have bought three of these. One for me and two for Christmas presents. I love it and you will too!!!
Works great! Love the small cute cubes.

Never heard of one of these until I stumbled onto one.  Did my research.  Della came out on top, hence this purchase.  Justification was I needed a reliable supply of ice (without the ice tray hassle) for rehabilitating a joint replacement.  Works fantastic.  Turn it on, do exercises, turn off, get ice and apply to joint.  Just the right amount.  Ice within 7 minutes of "switch on".  Only paying to make what I need.  Exercising 3x/day.  21 days so far.  So, 63+ uses.  Flawless.  Makes very functional, somewhat bullet (hollow) shaped, "cubes".  They cool beverages quickly, too.  Reasonably quiet.  About the size of a bread maker.  Doesn't impose too much on counter top.  Way less expensive than adding an ice maker to a refrigerator.  Plus, for the price, if it breaks, just buy another.  No water lines.  Put it where you want the ice.  It's cool to watch, too.  Very efficient.  Am considering giving one as a wedding gift as the couple has a "dry bar".  Perfect addition.  Verrry cool item.
I would have given this five stars, except that it quit working just over a year after we purchased it. If you buy one, definitely get the warranty (which wasn't available when we got ours).
Fantastic compact ice maker. Compact footprint, nicely shaped ice cubes, very easy to use.
only had it for a few days now but it makes ice quickly and works perfectly.
Started producing ice almost immediately; very easy to set up and use.

Bought this for camping, and I am impressed with its capability.  Nine Ice cubes at a time and the first ones are done within about 5-7 min.  This is a great little ice maker and I hope to get lots of use out of it.
Loving it
Makes ice very quickly. Living in AZ I like to have plenty of ice. I would treat it like a refrigerator when moving it . I also get to use spring water or filtered water. So far it is great!
Love it ! Perfect for the RV!
I can't imagine going back to freezing plastic ice trays, this is too convenient... makes a batch of ice every 6 minutes
Ice melts as fast as it makes it.

This thing is a workhorse! After my refer ice maker quit, I needed a way to make ice and not buy ice. It may take a couple of hours to fill my freezer ice tray but the wait is well worth it. I would buy this again.
Makes ice quckly and easy to use.
Great buy.. makes quick ice and isn't loud at all.
Ice Maker works quickly and seems to do what we ask of it. No complaints and it is ideal for our needs.

😀 Just got my Della Icemaker yesterday. Made my first batch if ice today. Actually very quiet, which I did not expect. Thank you to the prior reviews that made me purchase this. Will save ne tons of time, money and inconvenience this summer.
Quick way to freeze ice. Easy to use and clean.

DO NOT BUY. It worked for a while and then started producing giant ice chunks instead of ice cubes. After a while that issue stopped and it worked for a bit, but now it just doesn't work at all! It will only produce ice cubes the size of my pinky nail. AWFUL.

I never write reviews but I love this ice machine!  Our expensive Samsung refrigerator's ice machine consistently broke and was costing even more money to maintain.  With three kids in sports I needed ice constantly.  We bought this 6 months ago and it's been cranking out ice every day.  We keep it on our kitchen counter right next to our sink/water sprayer so we can keep it filled.  Love love love this product.  I got the silver one and it goes great with my stainless steel appliances.

I saw folks in a FB group for RV'rs talking about ice makers.  I use a lot of ice but don't have an ice maker in my refrigerator.  So I thought I'd give this a try.  I'm very impressed with it!  Love it!  It makes ice in 6 minutes and you can either dump it into a container and put the ice in your freezer or don't worry about it.  The ice will eventually melt but the machine will just freeze it into cubes again.  I bring it with me in my travel trailer so I'm never without ice even if I'm way off the beaten path.

This stopped working slowly, which is really annoying. It worked well for a few months, then the ice cubes got smaller and smaller and now it just recycles water. Of course it's outside of the return window and the request to return has been denied - not a company that stands by their product, which is a shame.
Worked great for about six months. Now the "full" light is stuck on and won't cycle. Disappointed.
Love it
It is A Piece shit. Only used less than 20 times then it is broke. Just save your money! If there is 0 star, I will rate below that. This is the worst products I bought online.

Works great - looks nice and makes lots of ice quickly.  Bought this as a alternate to replacing the one in my fridge that broke - AGAIN.  It is pretty loud and big on my counter are really my only complaints.
Performed exactly as advertised!  Very Satisfied.

You know how the "Ice Full" LED indicator light nearly blinds you when you get within five feet from this ice maker? You can prevent this by dabbing a bit of 'White Out' on the top surface of the LED light. (White Out is a tiny bottle of white paint that used to be used with typewriters, 10 years ago, to correct misspelled words ). Also, every time ice is needed you'll have to have an ice pick to break it into small pieces. But, happy with it.

Now, after operating for a couple of weeks, I have a helpful hint. I was getting ice that was thicker at the top, of the unit, than bottom. The sheet of cubes didn't drop quite right. So, I put a quarter (coin) under each of the front legs. By lifting the front a little, it changed the way the cubes were being made. It works better.
My pour over coffee maker is great.  Easy to use and takes up no room to store.
I love this pour over filter. It works great, filters well and is easy to clean.

This worked great - super easy and coffee was delicious!  We like to use this type when we travel and this one was particularly nice in not having to remember filters.  I honestly have no idea why someone would bother with a Keurig when it's this easy to make a good cup of coffee.  Quite often we make "coffee for one" so this is perfect for us.

It's great to have gotten away from using paper filters in a plastic holder. This filter does make a better cup of coffee. BUT, the design of the base is a problem. The circumference of the bottom piece should be a bit larger. As it is, it barely fits on the rim of my coffee cup. A slight, inadvertent tap, and the entire filter, grounds, hot water, and all falls over. It has happened two times so far (I've made about a dozen cups of coffee with the filter so far).

Update, 4/1/16 -- It just happened again, with the slighted inadvertent tap, the filter, full of coffee grounds and very hot water, spilled all over my kitchen counter and down to the floor. What a hot mess!! I thought I would just "make it work", being super careful when I use this. BUT, the spills continue to happen due to the poor design of this product. About one in every three attempts results in a disaster. I am looking for a better product, unfortunately, this one will have to go to the scrap pile.

Easily and quickly makes a great cup of coffee. It's more hands on than other methods (which are pretty hands off, i.e. Keurig and drip coffee makers) and takes more time and energy--but it doesn't take much. Literally the best cup of coffee I've had. The taste of the coffee is distinct from others I have tried, it really does taste smoother, it also has some sort of extra depth whose origin I can't pinpoint but that I like a lot.

Another thing I like about this pot is that it's small, easily goes anywhere, I can shove it in the cupboard with my cups when not in use. It produces zero waste since I don't have to buy filters and if it ever stops working or gets broken for some reason, I can recycle it because it's stainless steel.
So impressed with this little guy!  Coffee taste great, easy clean up and no more paper waste!  Think of all the money you will save by no longer having to buy filters!
I LOVE this classy coffee maker! It works great, and looks really good with my other stainless appliances. Good job!

Around new years I ordered an aeropress (plastic with a rubber plunger) and within 2 months the rubber has gone whooshy causing it to explode coffee around the kitchen from the air pressure escaping through the wobbly rubber.

I decided to go with a coffee dripper. I was about to get a cheaper plastic one with paper filters like a friend had but saw this stainless steel one for just $19.99 so I thought I'd get it. I've been using it for about a month now. It's not press coffee, but it's coffee that doesn't explode. And aeropress wants $9 + shipping just for the rubber replacement, for what another 2 mo? No way.

I have read other reviews perhaps not on this stainless dripper but others that they can be weaker as they are thin metal so be careful with the base. I make coffee about every other day and will definitely update if I see any signs of wear early on.

Update 4/23/2016 I've been using this dripper prettymuch every day, but now it doesn't seem to flow through. I washed it with hot soapy water yesterday, and took the soap water with the dripper and put it on the other side of the sink to see how it would drain. I came back about 6 or 8 hours later in the day and it still had about 1" from the bottom full of water that had not drained. I think all the holes are plugged up from coffee but even hot water didn't clean it? First that aeropress at almost exactly 2 months, and now this at just under 2 months. How do I make coffee?? Any

Delicious cup of coffee.  I usually drink drip coffee.  Occasionally use a french press.  I don't prefer the french press because it is grainy at times.  (probably a user error/grinding too finely).  However, this pour-over is excellent.  The filter does a fantastic job with the grains of the coffee, but allows through all the taste of the french press.  Really enjoyable.  This is our first pour over.  It is nice aesthetically and does a great job technically.  we will use it often.  Easy to clean and efficient.  We switch between two cups half-way to get the most out of the coffee.  :)
I find it quick and easy to use,while making  a good cup of coffee

I just made my first pour-over. I'm drinking it right now!  I don't know why it's so much better than a regular drip coffee maker, but it is. Mmmmm. If you're thinking about Keurig, get this instead. I have both and a one-cup pour-over takes about the same time to make (with your water already hot), it doesn't fill up the landfill with pod cups and you'll spend less on coffee. Did I mention it tastes a lot better?
I have used this every morning since it's quick delivery.  I use decafe and it tastes fine.  Never bitter, It is quick and easy to clean.

Wow, why did I wait so long to buy this?  Our old stove top percolator left a lot to be desired, but I didn't want to use an electric counter top coffee maker.  This seemed like a strange alternative, but it should have been my first choice.  The coffee is brewed very quickly, and tastes amazing, with absolutely no grounds in the cup.  I brew two large cups at a time, by setting this on top of a wide mouth mason jar, and it works very nicely that way.  I use 4 Tbsp of pre-ground coffee.  The base is about 1/4" wider than the mason jar, and has a small lip to prevent it from sliding off.  The taste from this just doesn't even compare with a percolator.  Coffee is a pleasure to drink again, thank you Willow & Everett!
Cute, easy to clean and totally portable!

I plan on using this on backpacking trips as a replacement for a plastic pour over. The weight is negligible but it is very sturdy. More importantly, though, it makes a mean cup of joe and is incredibly easy to clean.
Works very well and is easy to clean
Works great!
Works great and should last forever.

Love this. Could just be all in my head, but I actually think the coffee tastes cleaner and slightly more full than when using a paper filter. Have even bought for other family members since my purchase. Made well, looks great as well. Way better than that cheap plastic filter holder I had - and you most likely still do...

Update Feb 2016. The base snapped off about a month ago. I always wash by hand, and the base just sort of fell off. Reattached the base utilizing a food-grade epoxy, but still disappointing that it broke.
I am very impressed with this drip system. Only thing I have to do to improve it is to get some good coffee and grind it in my grinder to course and really enjoy.
Does just what it's supposed to. Stainless steel looks nice! And you don't need filters!
The only problem I have is I love to compost my coffeegrounds and the only way to clean this is wash them out. I can still use a paper filter with it...

I bought this item based on reviews.  I still used a paper filter since cleaning it after each use was a pain the the [*^%].  It works OK.  I also bought a ceramic one and like it much better.  I would have returned this item but I used it and I didn't think it right to do that.

***UPDATE *** I am revising this review to reflect the excellent customer service I have immediately received from the seller. I have received a full refund for this item and am also awaiting a free replacement to arrive in the mail. Evidently, the original purchase was from a faulty batch of filters. Thank you!
This product concept is a great one and I eagerly purchased this item and was happy to clear my kitchen counter of the dinosaur coffeepot. Sadly, this product has ended up being a big disappointment, even though I have tried the recommended coarse ground coffee. It takes FOR. EV. ERRRRR to make just a single cup of coffee. Got a few good cups out of it early on, but I dread making coffee in the morning now. Thought this was a good idea to try, but now shopping again :(

I have to start with saying that this is a great product, it cuts down on paper waste and is easy to wash. I used it almost everyday and went through a a couple pounds of coffee, washing it out every time i used it. On my last use it broke in two pieces while washing it. I feel ripped off.

LOVE this product! I was tired of using the plastic version of this and was so happy to see that it comes in stainless steel. Super easy to clean too! The company sent it out right away and I was able to enjoy it as soon as it arrived. Thank you!
Worked well until it separated from its base. (Just over a month)
Hard to get the grounds out
Very good quality, works great and easy clean.
Easy to use, great quality, easy to clean, coffee tastes great. Highly recommend this purchase.

Wonderful coffee for one, two or three days then the screen becomes clogged and no matter how hard  you try it stays that way so future coffee is ice cold and old before its in your cup. I wrote to ask how to fix and they told me to use a dishwasher. I live in NYC. We don't have dishwashers at my income level other than the hands typing up this unfortunate review. Sorry to have to report this because its a great idea.
It's everything I was hoping for, easy to use and store, plus no paper filters to dispose of adding to my trash. 👍🏻👍🏻

This is the most useful and least demanding appliance I own!  It fits everywhere, the coffee comes out perfect,  I don't need to plug it in anywhere and I'm not constantly throwing out old leftover coffee!  I cannot take credit for finding it, however.  My friend who was sick of her Keurig not working, out of desperation and an overabundance of time on her hands (don't tell her I said that) found this on Amazon.  She asked if I'd order it for her, so I figured, well, I might as well get one for myself as I'd just given up my coffee maker to make more space on the counter and was contemplating a French press.  I'm so thrilled I ordered it.  It's brilliant in its simplicity, never breaks down, cleans up so easily and my camellia is now enjoying more coffee grounds around her roots than ever before, while I am sipping my freshly made cup of coffee!

I liked this so much I bought two. One for work and one for home. Incredibly simple to use. People can keep their damn K-Cups, I want real coffee. If I can see through the coffee, it isn't strong enough. I use 4 tablespoons of any coffee, makes a great cup.

One recommendation - after use, clean with dish soap to ensure that the screen doesn't get clogged. Mine got clogged after about 3 uses - I was rinsing with water only. After cleaning it each time though it works great.

Great quality pour over coffee maker with two layers of mesh, one the outer frame while the second is an inner mesh.  The unit I received did not include the coffee scoop.  Wish the disk on the bottom had more than three spot welds, I can see these breaking if dropped.
Seems to get clogged, even when using medium or coarse grain.

I waited 3 months to try this product out before writing a review. I followed the instructions to use larger size grind coffee not small, yet the tiny metal mesh holes must be plugged up. It takes forever to make one cup of coffee. $20 down the drain!
After a while of using this, there is build up between the filters. You cannot take them apart to clean unfortunately. Going back to paper filter.

This little pour over coffee Dripper is a very nice one. However, it's very small for making a whole pot of coffee. Did I not pay attention to the size and get one that is actually for only one cup? Do they make a larger  one?
Excellent quality, highly recommend it!  It was delivered promptly and I would certainly order from this company again.

My husband and I are very happy with the stainless steel coffe dripper. It's exactly what we were looking for. Comes with a stainless steel measuring spoon.  Excellent quality. Follow directions on use and cleaning and you'll be very happy with it.
Love the brew factor. Makes a great cup of coffee, but fell apart after two days. The metal rim separated from the cone and there's no way to get it to stay back on. I will be returning it.

I love it! I waitedto write a review until I had a real chance to use it every day and see how it held up. Easy to clean. I use a brush after each use. No clogging. Coffee tastes so fresh and strong. Taking the time makes me appreciate each cup.
Works well, no issues so far with drainage due to coffee. I believe you need to not have Fine mix and this is than the right Dripper
Excellent quality and craftsmanship.
Clogs, even with a paper filter. Nice scoop though.
Quick delivery. I am looking forward to giving this to my husband for Christmas since his old coffee dripper is a trial to work with. I love it that it is stainless and no filters are necessary!
Got this for my father-in-law and he loves it!
Nice and works wonderfully making a nice cup of joe.

'I bought the Willow & Everett Pour Over Coffee Dripper to have on hand for Thanksgiving dinner for a few reasons: only 1 person in the family drinks coffee; I didn't want another rarely used appliance taking up valuable cabinet space; no paper filters to buy and the great sale price. Directions were clear & easy to follow. The family coffee drinker said her coffee tasted great. Quick cleanup. Sits atop a coffee mug for perfect storage'

This product is absolutely beautiful. I purchased this as a Christmas gift so I do not know how well it will perform until I get feedback from the recipient of this gift. But I will say, that if it works and the coffee is as good tasting as the product is good looking. it will deserve a 10 star rating if there is such a thing.

This arrived several days earlier than expected. When I saw it, I had concerns that it would be difficult to clean because the outer 'membrane' wouldn't allow a spray of water back toward the interior. But there is absolutely no problem. It works great and cleans beautifully.  The device is entirely stainless steel, so it can be cleaned easily in the dishwasher!

We have tried every brew method known to man including several french press designs but this simple device is a terrific piece of hardware.  I use a large 18 ounce cup and this is the only one that accomodates any size cup very nicely. Once you find the right amount of water and coffee to fit your preferrences, it gives the same wonderful cup of coffee every time.  We have been using it for about a year and we buy several as gifts for friends and family.  It washes easily under running water.  Start to finish is the fastest method for brewing and clean-up that I have ever used.

bought this as a christmas gift so i haven't used the item myself, but i did check it out after it arrived. it is a quality product and i wish it had my name on it under the tree! i received a follow up email from one of the owners, giving me a couple pro-tips about how to use it, just in case i decided to skip over the instructions. thumbs up, folks. i like it.

I am surprised at how quickly I can make a cup of coffee with this dripper.  It takes much less time than a French press and just seems to taste better than one of those fancy cup at a time brewers.  The 2 Tbls scoop is versatile, too.  Both dripper and scoop seem to be well made and should last quite a while with proper care and handling.
Bought this for travel. Not as heavy as I feared. Good deal.
Seems to be well made and will save on filters. It will be easy enough to wash.

Excellent product and fantastic customer service. Would definitely buy from them again. The kettle and the stainless steel filter make a perfect pour over cup of coffee. Very glad to have found these products and a great company.
You get very strong coffee from the dropper which was the point of its design. Love it!
I love this pour over. It's much lighter than the ceramic types out there and I love that it doesn't require paper filters. Brews a great cup o' joe!
I love it. I believe that it's better and make coffee taster than paper filter.
Durable, nice, one cup brew.  Easier to clean than a French press.
It is exactly what it says it is
Makes a good cup o' Joe!
Very well made and great addition to my drip coffee system

Update: after 18 months, the weld issue surfaced, Not to mention a couple months ago I had gone to inserting a paper filter to get better flow.

Works great in the beginning and continues to do so with proper cleaning.
Tips: don't let the grounds dry in the filter, it will clog quicker. Once a week, clean with high-pressure water/air (garden hose, air compressor)

If you have the weld issue, send it back or use a tall cup

A cheap knock off that got worse with every cup. the pour is soo slow i end up with iced coffee by the time it fills up a 12oz cup. I went back to using a standard paper filter V60 and when i forgot to buy more papers i grabbed this thing back out of the cupboard for a redemption cup of coffee... consider this filter "un-redeemed".
coffee's flavor is on par, though... so i'll at least have that to think about as i throw this in the garbage.

Received this item as a Christmas gift but from day one I cannot get a full cup of coffee without waiting for 20 minutes. I have tried everything from pour the water slowly to quickly and every variation in between. Fortunately, I only use this at work and make one cup a day because it could not handle any more use than that. I clean out the filter immediately and have put it through the dishwasher several times. Wish it would work better because I like the concept.

UPDATE - 3/15/2017 Willow and Everett Customer service is top notch. Every company should take a page out of their book because they made this right. I just used my new dripper for the first time and I received a full cup of coffee and did not have to wait 20 minutes, Thanks I am updating my review to 5 stars.
The water stays in. coffee only drips out

Worked great for a couple of weeks, then it seems that the filter clogs. I haven't yet figured out how to get it " factory clean" again. I've had it for about 3 months, and can't think of anything else to try. Not worth the $$.

Just changed this to 5 stars. I reached out to customer service at Willow and Everett describing my problem, and what is done to try to resolve it. They quickly sent me out a replacement that works better than the first one ever did. Making my coffee is a pleasure now. As simple as this device seems, I appear to have gotten one with a mesh that was too tight, and wouldn't let water flow properly it was triply defective. It happens with any manufactured item. That's where customer service comes in, and the service I received from Willow and Everett was fantastic.

I LOVE this!!!! It's super simple to use and to keep clean. I used to make french press coffee every day but was annoyed with spending 10-15 minutes cleaning it every day. Now I brew the coffee grounds in hot water in one cup, then pour it through the dripper into another cup. It's much faster, easier to wash everything, and tastes the exact same.

I LOVE this!!!! It's super simple to use and to keep clean. I used to make french press coffee every day but was annoyed with spending 10-15 minutes cleaning it every day. Now I brew the coffee grounds in hot water in one cup, then pour it through the dripper into another cup. It's much faster, easier to wash everything, and tastes the exact same.

Bought this for kayaking trip. Wanted a coffee filter that needed no paper filters and was study enough to handle a bit of rough play. Tiny holes clogs from the oils in coffee grounds, no matter the grind. After several mornings of frustrated coffee drinkers, I was afraid to leave my tent. Enough said......
Worked very well for awhile then the mesh became clogged and there was no way to clean it.  I need up throwing git out and going back to paper filters in a filter holder.  Very disappointed!
works great, does great in dishwasher, make drip coffee w/o a filter and not using one of those coffee makers that get full of mold
Works great, the coffee is delicious and the washes easily. Looks solid but has micro holes that allow a nice steep before dripping.

I ordered two of these: one for myself and another as a gift. Mine worked great, but the gift recipient had trouble with theirs filtering slowly. We thought it might be the difference in coffee variety or grind coarseness, but after months of experimenting and thoroughly cleaning we decided it must be a problem with the filter itself. I contacted Willow & Everett about the issue to see if an exchange might be possible, and customer service offered a replacement, no questions asked. The new filter works like a charm. Great product and customer service.

very simple my wife likes a pot with coffee water mixed. The grain creates mess.
this works very clean
good coffee.
This is great for when I want coffee a little more fancy than usual and I'm too lazy to use the coffee machine. I get a much richer flavor using this pour over.
Savings with the twin pack.
arrived quickly, works great!
Works beautifully, great substitute for the more expensive Samsung.

This is the first time I have bought any filters made by a company other than Samsung.  They installed exactly the same, the filtered water tastes exactly the same, and so far (weeks now) we cannot tell any difference except in the price!

Was not the item pictured, but the sticker on the package indicates it's the item they are intending to send. Didn't fit the fridge despite me ordering it by the part number. Needed the item yesterday for my family before a long trip since our water tastes bad without a filter. Bummer that they make the choice misrepresent like that.
